title: SY MONOMACHINE
author: gdeo607 (Digi Mono), Inigo Hernandez (MONO2K), Synfact port
description: One Monomachine-style machine: twelve TYPEs including SID-6581, FM+STAT, FM+PAR and FM+DYN from MONO2K. Eight SYN controls including TUNE; no MACRO. Clean-room engines on AUDIO CPU, not original Monomachine firmware.
